# CrashChest

**Category:** World  
**Aliases:** CrashChest

## What it does

Generates a chest that essentially bans people from the server if they have too many copies of it in their inventory. WARNING: This cannot be undone. Use with caution!  If copies are instead placed in a chest, anyone who opens the chest will be kicked from the server (just once).

Description basis: [publisher description](https://github.com/Wurst-Imperium/Wurst7/blob/4fa258b7b339f1823e73ae8455c404209e3690cd/src/main/resources/assets/wurst/translations/en_us.json). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).

**Scope note:** Wurst describes a harmful item payload from an older client snapshot. This catalog does not establish that it works against stock Minecraft 26.3.
